subject: english
title: Story Clue Crew · Q2 W06 D02
objective: Use details from a story to explain characters, events, and ideas.
introduction: Ana lost her red pencil in the classroom! Use the story clues to tell who is there, where it happened, and why.

vocabulary.definition: the person or animal in the story
where and when the story happens
something that happens in the story

activities.instruction: Hear how story clues tell who, where, and what happened!
activities.content: Ana lost her red pencil in the classroom. She looked under her desk and found it. She smiled because her drawing could continue.

feedback.correct: Nice detective work! The clues told you all about Ana's story! 📚
feedback.retry: Look at the example again and try once more. 💪

items.explanation: The story is about Ana, so she is the character.
The story happens in Ana's classroom, so that is the setting.

options.text: The pencil was on the teacher's table.
Ana found the pencil in her bag.
Ana lost her red pencil and found it under her desk

items.explanation: The story tells that Ana lost her red pencil and found it under her desk — that is the main event.

items.prompt: Which detail is TRUE from the story?

options.text: The pencil was on the teacher's table.
Ana found the pencil in her bag.
Ana found the pencil under her desk.

items.explanation: The story says Ana found the pencil under her desk, so that detail is true.

items.prompt: How did Ana feel at the end of the story?
items.explanation: Ana found her pencil again, so she felt glad at the end.
